sources.title: Columbia University Libraries official CLIO Open Catalog Data MARCXML downloads and current 111-piece index
sources.quality_notes: Official CLIO Open Data documentation says MARCXML holdings records released CC0, refreshed monthly; source-issued lito directory lists 111 compressed MARCXML shards as of 2026-10-11. Full scan not completed, publisher warns records may have omissions and format changes; CLIO public catalog access currently returned Anubis denial. A single shard result, positive or nonhit, is not yet physical copy/folio attestation. No 1827/1869 image or ancient glyph source.
